name: Vidosser
author: sweetyshots123
description: Collection of video viewing tools for WanGP. Frame stepping with the mouse wheel (one notch = one frame, Shift = 10, Ctrl = short jump; by default only in fullscreen) and the keyboard (A/S = previous/next frame, Q/W = short jump); save the exact displayed frame at full resolution (D or middle click, PNG/JPG, save-as dialog or direct to a folder) with message, flash and shutter-sound feedback; fullscreen that keeps overlays visible; loop all videos, L = loop this video, I/O/U = frame-accurate A-B segment loop. Works on the output gallery and every video player. Settings in the 'Vidosser' tab.
